description: This file contains unit tests for the TalkDirectiveParser class, validating its ability to parse various directive JSON strings and handle different cases and key variations.

classes.name: TalkDirectiveParserTest
classes.description: A test class containing multiple unit tests to verify the behavior of TalkDirectiveParser parsing logic.

methods.name: parsesDirectiveAndStripsHeader
methods.description: Tests that the parser correctly extracts directive fields and strips header text from input.

methods.name: ignoresUnknownKeysButReportsThem
methods.description: Verifies that the parser ignores unknown JSON keys but reports them as unknown.

methods.name: parsesAlternateKeys
methods.description: Checks that alternative key names and values are parsed correctly.

methods.name: returnsNullWhenNoDirectivePresent
methods.description: Ensures that the parser returns null directive when input JSON is empty or has no directive.
